title: L1 Network & Cyber Security Operations Engineer
description:
L1 Network & Cyber Security Operations Engineer, Dubai on-site, rotational 24/7 shifts. Monitor client networks (Auvik), investigate security alerts (Microsoft Defender, Huntress SIEM, Heimdal, Cisco Umbrella), troubleshoot following approved procedures, escalate to senior engineers, use Datto RMM.
What you'll bring: around 1-2 years of experience in network support, cybersecurity, a NOC/SOC or managed IT services; TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, wireless; basic knowledge of cyber threats and log analysis. CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Security+ or Microsoft security certifications desirable.

title: System and Network Engineer
description:
Systems and Network Engineer. Urgent hiring; valid UAE driving licence preferred. System maintenance and support, end-user technical support, project documentation, continuous improvement.
Qualifications: Bachelor's degree; 3-5 years in systems or network engineering; operating systems (Windows, Mac); cloud platforms (O365, AWS, Azure); familiarity with CCTV, PABX and structured cabling; design and deploy LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPN; configure routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN, Wi-Fi. Preferred certifications: CCNA, Fortinet NSE4 or greater, MCSE, AWS Solutions Architect.

title: Network Engineer (Hybrid Infrastructure & Cloud)
description:
Contract role. 7-10 years of experience in enterprise network and security environments, preferably Banking, Financial Services or regulated industries. Manage network and security: routers, switches, firewalls, firmware upgrades, hardening; Azure hub-and-spoke network connectivity, VPN gateways, ExpressRoute, NSGs; cloud firewall policies; security vulnerability assessments; coordinate managed service providers (SOC/NOC); RCA, QoS tuning, routing optimisation, firewall rule cleanup; documentation, CAB meetings; level 2/3 support; on-call and shift-based operations.
Essential: Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, network engineering or cybersecurity. Desirable: CCNA mandatory or strongly preferred; CCNP an advantage; Fortinet NSE (NSE 4 / NSE 5 / NSE 7) or equivalent firewall certification; TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, VPN, firewalls, IPS/IDS, WAF, Zero Trust, SIEM-based monitoring; Azure networking and hybrid cloud connectivity.

title: Network Security Engineer
description: IT Network Engineer: technical systems and user support for clients; troubleshoot client network and Wi-Fi issues; configure, deploy and manage routers, switches, firewalls and other network appliances; review logs and performance data. Candidates must hold relevant networking certifications, preferably Cisco-certified, Microsoft, HP Aruba. Preferred technical expertise: ACMP, CCNA, Routing, Switching, Firewall, Security, IP Telephony, Wireless, MPLS, VPN, Infrastructure.

title: Lead Engineer – OT Cyber Security
description:
Lead OT Cyber Security Engineer advising customers in the energy and materials industries on industrial control system (ICS) cybersecurity: gap assessments per NIST, ISA 27001 and ISA/IEC-62443, OT cybersecurity resilience roadmaps, risk assessments, proposals and business development, representing the company in industry forums.
Essential: 10 plus years' experience in a similar role; IT/OT cybersecurity management systems and risk assessments; hands-on experience specifying and implementing industrial firewalls and deploying security solutions; configuring switches, routers and firewalls; exposure to control system vendors and industrial networking equipment. Qualifications: degree in engineering, science, computer science or mathematics; relevant IEC/ISA, GICSP or similar certification.
